description: Defines platform support functions, classes, and constants for Codec2 component allocator management in Android, including allocator store IDs, block pool management, and component store access.

classes.name: C2PlatformAllocatorStore
classes.description: Represents a store of platform allocator IDs for Codec2, including various backend types like ION, DMABUFHEAP, GRALLOC, BUFFERQUEUE, and BLOB.

methods.name: GetCodec2PlatformAllocatorStore
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the platform allocator store.

methods.name: GetCodec2BlockPool
methods.description: Retrieves a block pool for a specified component and pool ID.

methods.name: CreateCodec2BlockPool
methods.description: Creates a block pool with specified allocator ID and components.

methods.name: GetTestComponentStore
methods.description: Returns a test component store, for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetPreferredCodec2ComponentStore
methods.description: Sets the preferred component store for accessing its interface.

methods.name: GetPreferredLinearAllocatorId
methods.description: Returns the preferred linear buffer allocator ID based on pool mask.
